newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:
Sales of 5,600 MT--all to Mexico--were 90 percent below the previous week and the 4-week average. Sales of 16,100 MT for delivery in the 1997/98 marketing year were all for Japan.
Exports of 15,900 MT were down 82 percent from the prior week and 74 percent from the 4-week average. Japan (15,100 MT) and Mexico (800 MT) were the destinations.
